phases.title: Demo 1: The Cottage
phases.summary: A short, finished slice you can download and play: the cottage and meadow, three small quests, a closing beat, options and credits, on Windows.

items.title: Three quests, tracked in the journal, with a closing beat
Save and load mid-quest and after each quest
A scripted test per quest, CI green
Options (volumes, mouse sensitivity, restart, quit) and credits
Windows build that runs from a clean folder
60 fps at 1080p, measured
items.note: 90-190 fps measured at 1600x900; true 1080p still to run.

phases.title: A Cottage, a Mage, and a Memory
phases.summary: A sunlit meadow, Edda's cottage with a real interior, a rigged elven mage, the Field of Flowers spell, text dialogue, and one warm story recorded as a memory.

items.title: Meadow terrain, grass, wildflowers and scenery
Field of Flowers spell and spell framework
Text dialogue with choices and stable line IDs
The Garden Behind the Cottage quest and memory event
Original audio: ambience, SFX, meadow theme
Freyja remade in VRoid, with her own outfit

phases.title: Village and Quests
phases.summary: Brenn's village to the south: lived-in homes, schedules, small humane errands and an eccentric grimoire hunt.

phases.title: Companions and Campfires
phases.summary: Two travelling companions who follow, banter and have their own priorities. Shared meals and scenic walks.

phases.title: Dungeons and Combat
phases.summary: Readable third-person magic combat, barriers and creature weaknesses, ruins and caves worth exploring.

phases.title: Relationships and Memories
phases.summary: Memory events grow into a living journal. Promises, gifts and callbacks to moments you actually lived.

phases.title: Time and Generations
phases.summary: Years and decades pass: aging, descendants, inherited homes, and people who remember the elf from their grandparents' stories.

phases.title: Storybook Prologue
phases.summary: An illustrated, animated flipbook of the original journey and the fall of the Hollow King.

phases.title: World Expansion and Polish
phases.summary: More regions, seasons, performance, accessibility and the long arc toward the coast.

updates.title: The first playable slice
updates.body: Freyja can walk the meadow road, step into Edda's cottage, hear about Jonas's garden and grow it back with the Field of Flowers. The moment is written into her journal as a memory. Everything is an early prototype: scripted 3D models, synthesised audio, and a lot still to polish.
